name: scroll-velocity-blur-hero
title: Scroll Velocity Blur Hero
description: A hero whose letters gain directional blur proportional to scroll speed and settle crisp at rest — using a stacked text-shadow trick instead of filter blur so it stays GPU-cheap even on long pages.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Scroll Velocity Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
